## Librerías
```{r}
library(Biostrings)
library(seqinr)
library(adegenet)
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(DECIPHER)
library(viridis)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
```

## 1. 20 variantes del COVID en distintos países
```{r}
virus <- c(
  "MZ472095.1", "MZ363983.1", "MT079851.1", "PX063729.1", "MZ544366.1",
  "MT350282.1", "OQ050422.1", "MW466799.1", "LC633754.1", "MT956911.1",
  "OL989073.1", "ON531991.1", "ON531991.1", "MT844029.1", "MT466071.1",
  "MW467418.1", "MT706050.1", "MT470100.1", "OM002608.1", "PZ297803.1"
)

seq <- read.GenBank(virus, species.names = TRUE, as.character = FALSE)
ape::write.FASTA(seq, file = "covid.fasta")
virus_seq <- readDNAStringSet("covid.fasta")
```

## 2. Calcular la longitud de las secuencias
```{r}
seq_lengths <- width(virus_seq)
seq_lengths_named <- data.frame(
  Secuencia = names(virus_seq),
  Longitud = seq_lengths
)

seq_lengths_named
```

## 3. Gráfica bases de ADN
```{r}
nucleotide_composition <- function(dna) {
  bases <- c("A", "C", "G", "T")
  chars <- strsplit(as.character(dna), "")[[1]]
  counts <- sapply(bases, function(base) sum(chars == base))
  percentages <- round((counts / length(chars)) * 100, 2)
  list(counts = counts, percentages = percentages)
}

compositions <- lapply(virus_seq, nucleotide_composition)

composition_table <- data.frame(
  Virus = names(virus_seq),
  A = sapply(compositions, function(x) x$percentages["A"]),
  C = sapply(compositions, function(x) x$percentages["C"]),
  G = sapply(compositions, function(x) x$percentages["G"]),
  T = sapply(compositions, function(x) x$percentages["T"])
)

composition_data <- reshape2::melt(composition_table, id.vars = "Virus")

ggplot(composition_data, aes(x = Virus, y = value, fill = variable)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Comparación de bases de ADN",
    x = "Virus",
    y = "Porcentaje (%)"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("A" = "blue", "C" = "green", "G" = "red", "T" = "yellow"))
```

## 4. Análisis jerárquico
```{r}
aligned <- AlignSeqs(virus_seq)
aligned_dnabin <- as.DNAbin(aligned)

# Calcular la matriz de distancia
dist_matrix <- dist.dna(aligned_dnabin, pairwise.deletion = TRUE)

tree <- nj(dist_matrix)

plot(tree, main = "Árbol Filogenético de SARS-CoV-2 por Países")
ape::add.scale.bar()
```
